## Reflection
First India session (entries 09:36 IST, review at 15:05 IST; the Accounts table above was taken at midday).
- **Close:** LLM-reviewed Rs 10,03,674 (+0.37%), LLM off Rs 10,04,898 (+0.49%), Nifty 50 +1.07% (22,698.85 to ~22,943).
  LLM edge -0.12 pp. Both books trailed the index mainly because both held about 61-68% cash: bear regime (Nifty
  below its 200-DMA) halves new buys, so the books are only a third invested.
- **Difference from the control:** the review vetoed LAURUSLABS and softened five Buys to Overweight (Hold ratings on
  ADANIPORTS, DIVISLAB, ZYDUSLIFE, NYKAA, ETERNAL), so the reviewed book held fewer shares of each (e.g. ADANIPORTS 20
  vs 27, ETERNAL 115 vs 153). It was a broad up day (ADANIPORTS +5.9%, ETERNAL +3.6% on the day), so the smaller
  sizes cost about 0.12 pp. That is one day of a rising market, not evidence about the Hold rule.
- **Veto outcome so far:** LAURUSLABS (results day, board meeting 29 Oct) +1.8% vs Nifty +1.1% by 15:05, excess about
  +0.7%: the veto cost a little on day 1. The 5-day excess in the vetoes table is the real test, as the results
  reaction plays out.
- **Stops:** none hit; every position is 9-13% above its stop.
- **Lessons:** none added (one day). Candidate to watch: whether entry-day Hold size cuts on stocks with results 4-7
  trading days away (NYKAA, ZYDUSLIFE) pay off once those results land on 4 Nov.

- **Vetoes:** no outcomes yet. LLY and MRK report before tomorrow's open, so the 1-day outcome of the earnings vetoes

- **No stop-outs**, and no calls have elapsed outcome windows yet.
- **Process note:** in earnings season, 3 of the 8 top S&P 100 momentum names had results within 3 trading days.
  The earnings check is the most important part of the US review right now.
- **No lessons added:** no evidence yet. Candidate to watch: whether vetoing names into earnings beats holding them.

# India analyst review: data to 28 Oct 2026, trading 29 Oct

## Market context
- Nifty 50 closed at 22,698.85, **below its 200-day average** (1m -1.9%, 3m -5.4%): bear regime, so the engine halves new buys.
- With the SEPA trend template on, only 9 of 192 Nifty 200 stocks qualified. Leadership is narrow (pharma, a private
  bank, autos, platforms, defence).
- Earnings season: 4 of the 9 candidates report within ~7 trading days. One reports today.

## Ratings
| Symbol | Screen rank | Rating | Confidence | Reason / red flags |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LAURUSLABS | 1 | **Underweight (veto)** | 80 | Results board meeting **today** (NSE intimation); call 5pm; +12% above EMA50 at 52w high |
| DIVISLAB | 2 | Hold | 55 | Yahoo's 28 Oct bar missing, technicals unverifiable; results 7 Nov |
| BOSCHLTD | 3 | Overweight | 58 | SEPA 7/7, RS +21% (3m); results 6 Nov; no red flags |
| FEDERALBNK | 4 | **Buy** | 66 | Q2 record profit +45%, NPA at decade lows (16 Oct); event risk passed |
| NYKAA | 5 | Hold | 58 | Results 4 Nov, inside the first week |
| ZYDUSLIFE | 6 | Hold | 58 | USFDA approval (21 Oct) but results 4 Nov |
| ADANIPORTS | 7 | Hold | 55 | Q2 filed 28 Oct; numbers and reaction not yet verifiable |
| ETERNAL | 8 | Hold | 55 | Q2 profit +92% but missed estimates, stock -3.5% (21 Oct) |
| HAL | 9 | Overweight | 57 | SEPA 7/7, results 12 Nov; routine director change |

## Data issues found
- NSE's `event-calendar` no longer lists **today's** board meetings (LAURUSLABS missing), so the engine's results blackout
  would have missed it. NSE's `corporate-board-meetings` endpoint still shows it. Code fix to follow.
- Yahoo returned an empty (NaN) last bar for DIVISLAB. Code fix to follow (drop empty bars).

# Strategy change log

Config numbers (stops, sizing, screen) change only with evidence: a backtest plus paper results. Each entry: date,
change, evidence, expected effect. Review the effect after 20+ trading days.

| Date | Change | Evidence | Expected effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-28 | Hybrid mode default: momentum screen picks, LLM can only veto | Deep-dive research (FINSABER, KTD-Fin, Lopez-Lira) | LLM adds value only as a red-flag filter |
| 2026-10-28 | Slow momentum book + SEPA trend template (4×ATR stop, no fixed target, 20-day hold, 10 positions) | Nifty 200 backtest Jan 2024–Oct 2026: +10.2% vs −7.0% for swing exits (not significant) | Fewer trades, lower costs, winners run |
